name: Deployment Verification
description: Post-deployment verification process. Health checks, smoke tests, and regression checks to confirm a deployment is working correctly. This process is READ-ONLY — it verifies and reports but NEVER fixes issues or modifies systems.

target.description: What was deployed — service name, version, or deployment identifier

steps.title: Health check
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify, fix, restart, or change anything.

Verify ${target} is running in ${environment}:
1. Check that the service/process is up and responding (curl health endpoints, check process status)
2. Verify the correct version is deployed (check version endpoints, deployment labels, or container tags)
3. Check resource utilization — CPU, memory, disk are within normal ranges
4. Verify connectivity to dependencies (databases, APIs, queues) — read-only checks only
5. Check for error spikes in recent logs (last 5-10 minutes)

Do NOT restart services or modify configurations. Only observe and report.

Output: health status for each check (PASS/FAIL/WARN) with details.
steps.accept_criteria: Service is confirmed running or failure is documented. Version is verified. Resource utilization checked. Dependency connectivity verified. No systems were modified.

steps.title: Smoke test
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify, fix, restart, or change anything.

Test core functionality of ${target} in ${environment}:
1. Exercise the primary user-facing endpoints or functions (read-only operations)
2. Verify responses are correct — expected status codes, response formats, data integrity
3. Check latency — responses should be within acceptable thresholds
4. Test authentication/authorization flows if applicable (verify they work, don't change them)
5. Verify any critical integrations are functioning (webhooks, event processing, data sync)

Use only read-only operations (GET requests, read queries). Do NOT write test data to production.

Output: smoke test results for each core function (PASS/FAIL) with response details.
steps.accept_criteria: Core functionality tested with read-only operations. Each test has a PASS/FAIL result with details. Latency is within acceptable range. No data was written or modified.

steps.title: Regression check
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify, fix, restart, or change anything.

Check for regressions in ${target} after deployment to ${environment}:
1. Compare current behavior against known previous behavior (check project context for baseline)
2. Verify that features which worked before the deployment still work
3. Check error rates — compare current error rate against pre-deployment baseline
4. Look for new error types or warning patterns in logs
5. Verify data consistency — no corruption or missing records
6. Check that configuration values match expectations (not overwritten by deployment)

Do NOT fix any regressions found — only document them.

Output: regression check results (PASS/FAIL) with any regressions detailed.
steps.accept_criteria: Previous functionality verified against baseline. Error rates compared. No new error types or regressions, or regressions are clearly documented. No systems were modified.

steps.title: Produce verification report
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify, fix, restart, or change anything.

Produce a structured deployment verification report for ${target} in ${environment}:

1. **Overall Verdict**: One of: `HEALTHY`, `DEGRADED`, or `FAILED`
   - HEALTHY: All checks pass, deployment is good
   - DEGRADED: Some non-critical issues detected, service is functional but needs attention
   - FAILED: Critical issues detected, deployment may need rollback

2. **Health Check Results**: Status of each health check
3. **Smoke Test Results**: Status of each functional test
4. **Regression Results**: Any regressions detected
5. **Action Items**: What needs attention (but do NOT take action)

Store results in project context if project_id is available.

Write the verification report as a markdown file in the shared workspace directory (e.g., `deploy_verify_report.md`).

IMPORTANT: Do NOT attempt to fix issues or roll back. Only report the deployment status.
steps.accept_criteria: Verification report written as a file in the shared workspace. Report has clear HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED verdict. All check results included. Action items listed if applicable. No systems were modified.
